notes.title: Archery Update
notes.content:
We have vastly improved your archery aiming indicator in the latest update, and now you'll see how your arrow will fly through the air. This new feature should aid in your adventures through Runeflame's lands. Your feedback is welcome!

Check out this gif demonstrating the new archery display:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039952/0bb1c8bdb7936a5c85a814c1c72046df66668253.gif[/img]

We're looking forward to enhancing and adding to Runeflame's gameplay as we continue our Early Access track to full release! Keep an eye on the horizon...

notes.title: Patch notes for September 30th
notes.content:
Happy 30th! Some quick fixes for y'all:

[list]
[*] Improved collision and pathfinding in the temple ruins.
[*] Increased visibility of the navigable area before you've solved the temple ruin puzzle.
[*] Removed the "edge of the world" previously visible from the top of the temple ruins.
[/list]
